queries.query: Kaifeng official cadastral parcel map GIS real estate registration public map China
queries.scope: Find city-specific official registration/map sources and determine whether anonymous parcel geometry is documented.
queries.result: Kaifeng has a city-level real-estate registration center. Its official description confirms registration/cadastral administration and public inquiry services, while the separate city Tianditu page exposes general mapping. The official service guide requires applicant identification for registry-information inquiry. No anonymous parcel geometry or geometry-only public schema was verified; no registry notice content was accessed.

rootSupplementalResearch.observation: Official city real-estate registration center portal. Organization and service responsibilities confirm city-level registration operations; this review did not inspect registry announcement records or submit queries.

Center introduction states that the center is subordinate to the Kaifeng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and is responsible for city-level register, cadastral survey-result review, city platform maintenance, record management and public inquiry service.
Official service guide describes identity-required record inquiry; this is not an anonymous public parcel map.

City-specific public geographic-information portal, sponsored by Kaifeng Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and operated by Henan Map Institute. Displayed public service categories include basemaps, imagery, terrain, names, boundaries and generic geographic APIs; no cadastral parcel layer or parcel schema was identified.
